serviceName: RealViu website on your own domain
description: Points a brokerage's domain at their RealViu website and adds the certificate-validation record, so HTTPS is issued and renews without further changes. Both records must stay in place.
variableDescription: dcv: the certificate-validation target issued for this exact hostname, copied verbatim from the brokerage's RealViu domain settings (for example www.example.com.7079dafabe2bbc99.dcv.cloudflare.com). It is passed rather than composed from the domain so the value applied is always the one the certificate authority actually issued.
